cases.source: Linear combinations of orthonormal vectors use an orthonormal basis.
cases.criteria: orthonormal means mutually orthogonal AND unit norm: 标准正交 or 正交归一, never just 正交.

cases.source: We report on data practices from interviews with 53 AI practitioners. Data cascades are pervasive (92% prevalence).
cases.criteria: The 92% describes the interviewed practitioners in this study, not a population-wide rate; the Chinese must keep that scope.

cases.source: At test time the units are always present, and their outgoing weights are scaled so that the expected output is the same as during training.
cases.criteria: The expected output at test time equals the expected output during training; do not translate it as something that happens only during training.

cases.source: Speaker We use the term speaker to refer to the individual who produced linguistic behavior. Annotator The term annotator refers to people who assign annotations to raw data. Curator A third role in dataset creation, less commonly discussed, is the curator. Stakeholders Stakeholders are people impacted directly or indirectly by a system.
cases.criteria: Keep the four role paragraphs. In dataset creation, curator is the person who selects and organizes data (数据整理者／数据筛选者), not the exhibition sense 策展人.
